question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Resilient
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Able to recover quickly**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Resilient"** refers to the ability to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions; it implies toughness and adaptability. (लचीला / दृढ़) • **Example:** Despite the challenges, she remained resilient and completed her project on time. • **Explanation of the word:** • The word "Resilient" means someone or something that bounces back or recovers quickly from setbacks, adversity, or pressure. (लचीला) • **Hindi meaning:** (लचीला / जल्दी ठीक हो जाने वाला) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Able to recover quickly**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Overly sensitive** (अत्यधिक संवेदनशील): Refers to someone who reacts very strongly to small things, often emotionally. • **Example:** She is overly sensitive to criticism and often takes comments personally. • **Option 3: Easily distracted** (आसानी से विचलित हो जाने वाला): Refers to someone who cannot maintain focus and gets diverted by small things. • **Example:** He is easily distracted while studying, which affects his performance. • **Option 4: Weak and fragile** (कमजोर और नाजुक): Refers to something or someone that lacks strength or durability. • **Example:** The weak and fragile bridge collapsed under heavy weight. 37:T9b9, The correct answer is: **Option 2: Agitated**.
